en: A black-and-white panoramic view over a small European spa town nestled among hills and vineyards. The image shows dense traditional houses with pitched roofs, a prominent church tower in the center, and wooded slopes rising behind the town with scattered buildings and fields on the plateau beyond. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in German identifying the place as Bad Sulza with its vineyards.
